policy: Every listed zone is DISPUTED for every kernel (zero points, neither PASS nor WRONG), including unexecuted cells. The denominator and frozen v1 bands remain unchanged. Remove only with a v2 catalog or corrected, re-frozen twins and independent verification.

entries.reason: The v1 refusal-only contract is incorrect. FeatureScript opFillet defaults to allowEdgeOverflow=true, making the fillet feasible. An exact-class refusal must name unsupported edge overflow or the actual capability gap, never assert geometric infeasibility.
evidence: Frozen Onshape AC31 volume = 462.61566071096163 mm^3; independent OCCT BRepCheck reports valid and the shell is closed (independent twin audit, 2026-09-26).
Frozen input: fixtures/cad-acid/fs/acid-blend.fs, acidAC31; frozen output and checksums: fixtures/cad-acid/onshape/.
entries.resolution: v2 contract must describe the overflow geometry; re-freeze any changed twins.

entries.reason: The FS twin selects qCreatedBy(union, BODY), which is empty because the union keeps an input body. FILLET_SELECT_EDGES is a twin failure, not a Parasolid geometry verdict.
evidence: fixtures/cad-acid/fs/acid-blend.fs: acidAC36 (lines 175-183), unlike the acidResult(inputs, created) pattern used by other twins.
fixtures/cad-acid/onshape/: frozen AC36 feature error FILLET_SELECT_EDGES; no result body.
entries.resolution: Correct body selection and re-freeze the FS twin before v2 scoring.

entries.reason: The FS twin calls opDraft with DraftType.NEUTRAL_PLANE / neutralPlane. The documented signature requires DraftType.REFERENCE_SURFACE, referenceSurface and pullVec. The frozen REGEN_ERROR is a twin failure.
evidence: src/lang/dataflow/fs-trace.mjs accepts neutralPlane, diverging from real FS; this audit does not change that frontend behavior.
fixtures/cad-acid/onshape/: frozen AC38 feature error REGEN_ERROR.
entries.resolution: Correct the std call and re-freeze the twin; track the frontend signature divergence separately.

entries.reason: The OCCT twins substitute Cone/Torus primitives for the specified revolve operation. Primitive agreement is not evidence that the revolve construction works. Suspend these zones uniformly, not only for OCCT.
evidence: fixtures/cad-acid/b3d/acid_curved.py: ac25/ac26 use Cone/Torus; fixtures/cad-acid/b3d/acid_precision.py: AC48 uses Torus instead of revolve.
Independent twin audit (2026-09-26): genuine AC48 revolve produces a SurfaceOfRevolution with observed singularPoints=0, changing the frozen v1 OCCT verdict.
entries.resolution: Replace primitive shortcuts by actual revolve operations, re-freeze twins, and settle representation-independent singular-point measurement in v2.

annotations.reason: zones.json declares Boolean fuzzy value 0, but the frozen OCCT 7.8.1 twin does not call SetFuzzyValue and inherits Precision::Confusion() = 1e-7 mm.
evidence: fixtures/cad-acid/b3d/acid_curved.py:98-121: Boolean wrapper has no fuzzy override; frozen OCP version 7.8.1.1.post1.
annotations.scoreEffect: Informational only. No DISPUTED overlay and no strict-v1 point change. Practical tolerance requires OCCT-FUZZY-CONTACT-1 and a verified geometric witness.
annotations.resolution: Correct the descriptive kernel-class statement in a future catalog version; do not modify frozen v1 inputs.
